newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy completes Lawton well.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy completes Lawton well.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp saidit has completed the Lawton 27 1 well.

Located in the Masters Creek portion of the Louisiana Trend, the well tested at a daily rate of 3,000 barrels of oil and 9.2 million cubic feet of natural gas on a 30/64 inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 4,800 pounds per square inch.
Chesapeake owns a 97.5 percent working interest in the Lawton 27 and is drilling horizontally in the Lawton 4 1, a south offset to the Lawton 27.
The company said it plans to begin drilling three additional Lawton wells during the next several months.
